title: LFU Cache
summary: Cache that evicts the least frequently used key, breaking ties by least recently used; O(1) get and put.
approach: Map key → (value, freq); map freq → ordered keys (LRU within frequency); track the minimum frequency. On access, move the key to freq + 1.
complexity: O(1) per operation (with linked lists); the sketch below uses ordered arrays for clarity
body: Say explicitly that production O(1) needs a doubly linked list per frequency (like the LRU entry) and a key → node map.
